specific_objectives: 24.15.1.1 Trainee will be able to follow Electrostatic sensitive device handling practices in a workshop.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of ESD safe storage bin usage and wrist strap connection; Safety: Verify zero voltage before touching components; Supervision: Instructor monitors correct grounding technique.
intro_questions: What is the primary risk of static electricity to electronic components?
Where is the designated Special Handling Area located in the workshop?
Why must personnel remove metal jewelry before entering the ESD zone?

topics: Environmental controls in Special Handling Area
development.content:
Definition of Electrostatic Sensitive Devices
Characteristics of ESD damage
Identification of ESD symbols
Environmental controls in Special Handling Area
Flooring and workbench requirements

Personal grounding equipment usage
Wrist strap inspection and testing
Proper donning and doffing procedures
Footwear requirements for ESD zones
Handling tools and anti-static mats

Storage container specifications
Placement of components in bins
Labeling and inventory control
Transporting ESD items within workshop
Emergency procedures for ESD breaches

summary_questions: Explain the correct sequence for connecting a wrist strap to a component.
Describe two methods to verify that an anti-static mat is properly grounded.
Identify three prohibited actions inside the Special Handling Area.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a checklist of personal protective equipment required for entering the Special Handling Area, referencing the procedures to be detailed in LP 21.

pft_rows.syllabus: Do’s and don’ts of Electrostatic sensitive device handling.
